proposed_widenings.name: activated_weapon_coating_rider
proposed_widenings.justification: The item is a composite magic item whose bonus-action activation arms a persistent, weapon-scoped on-hit rider for up to 1 minute or until the first qualifying hit. Current magic-item mechanics only allow passive grants, immediate activations, triggered reactions, or composites of those; none can represent an activation that installs later on-hit save-gate behavior on one specific weapon attack.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take a Bonus Action to magically coat the blade with poison. The poison remains for 1 minute or until an attack using this weapon hits a creature.

proposed_widenings.name: on_hit_applied_effect_with_independent_duration
proposed_widenings.justification: On the hit that consumes the coating, the target makes a DC 15 Constitution save; on failure it takes poison damage and is Poisoned for 1 minute. That 1-minute target debuff outlasts the coating itself, so it cannot honestly be modeled as duration inherited from the armed-weapon effect. The surface needs a way for an on-hit rider to spawn a target-side timed effect with its own lifecycle.
proposed_widenings.evidence: That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 2d10 Poison damage and have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute.

notes: The passive +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this specific weapon fits existing passive magic-item atoms, but the poison-coating half does not fit any current magic-item component family honestly. I did not author content/magic_item_dagger_of_venom.dhall or derived artifacts.
